subtopic: Target Date Funds as 401(k) Default Investments
source_evidence: Some 401(k) plans use these funds as the default investment for plan participants who have not selected their investments under the plan.
question: How might a target date fund be used in a 401(k) plan when a participant has not chosen investments?
answer: Some 401(k) plans use target date funds as the default investment for participants who have not selected investments under the plan.
